question: Is the supported island-year covariance contrast robust to removal of any single Palmer island?
method: Repeat the exact frozen missingness-robust island-year coherence analysis on all five four-island subsets formed by omitting CHR, COR, HUM, LIT, or TOR. Recompute colony standardization, regional year residualization, coverage/abundance strata, pseudo-island permutations and the covariance contrast within each subset.
seed_rule: 20260927 + omission index in fixed order CHR,COR,HUM,LIT,TOR
decision_rule: uniform robustness requires every omission to retain a positive observed contrast and two-sided permutation p <= 0.05
boundaries: This is a post-positive robustness analysis, not an independent discovery test.
All five omissions are reported regardless of outcome.
Do not change eligibility, residualization, stratification, statistic or significance rule after results are opened.
